initialization: project-owned ru-mswc-personal-metric-v2; no external pretrained weights

acoustic_exclusions.policy: Training-only negative exclusions, manually selected before training. Keep all lexical labels and recordings unchanged. Never apply these exclusions to reported evaluation scores.

groups.reason: Same stress and identical spoken -ться/-тся ending; spelling does not supply an acoustic contrast.
Conservative exclusion of potentially indistinguishable unstressed -ом/-ам after a hard consonant. This is a phonetic risk annotation, not a claim that individual corpus clips were listened to.

acoustic_exclusions.implementation: Do not put excluded forms in the same metric episode; mask only their competing auxiliary-class logits. Do not merge classes, alter test labels or lower evaluation thresholds.

recipe.optimizer: AdamW; 400-step warmup, cosine decay to 5%; weight_decay=1e-4
recipe.loss: Symmetric angular prototype CE (learned scale) + normalized word CE (scale20 margin.15)
recipe.augmentation: 35% PCM synthetic white noise 15..35dB SNR; optional 0.03..0.12s echo 0.1..0.3 gain; 0.4..1.3 amplitude; time warp 0.9..1.1 and +/-5 frames; .015 scaled feature jitter
recipe.selection: Minimum dev same-owner FRR at dev pair-FAR<=1%; cross-speaker FRR breaks ties
recipe.input_statistics: Frozen v2 training-only MFCC mean/scale buffers
recipe.classifier_initialization: Mean v2 embeddings of 16 random training clips per class; no held-out features
recipe.episode_sampling: 50% same-owner multiword; 25% ordinary mixed speakers; 25% include up to six manually authored contrast pairs

mixed_speaker_closed_set_dev.support_policy: First hash-ordered clip per unseen word; distinct queries; no adaptation

mixed_speaker_closed_set_test.support_policy: First hash-ordered clip per unseen word; distinct queries; no adaptation

mixed_speaker_closed_set_dev.support_policy: First hash-ordered clip per unseen word; distinct queries; no adaptation

mixed_speaker_closed_set_test.support_policy: First hash-ordered clip per unseen word; distinct queries; no adaptation

regression.status: Previously inspected v2 benchmark; separate old-dev calibration

manual_curation.curation: Manually authored Russian word groups and contrast pairs; individual recordings are selected and checked automatically, not human-listened.
manual_curation.pair_policy: Different lexical labels remain negatives. Pairs increase their co-occurrence in training episodes; they are not merged or automatically relabeled.
manual_curation.evaluation_note: All new dev/test source sentences exclude every v1/v2 source sentence. Small genuinely new-word stratum is reported separately; the larger unchanged v2 test remains a regression benchmark.
manual_curation.recording_review: Automatic signal/decode/duplicate checks and existing source labels only. No claim of individual human listening or transcript-completeness verification.

limitations: Only 177 positive queries in the new test; small, correlated corpus sample
Genuinely new words are a small separate stratum; do not claim the entire new test has uninspected labels
Recording labels inherited from MSWC; no individual human listening or transcript-completeness audit
51,200 new real recordings; training augmentations are not counted as additional human examples
Pair false accepts are not false activations per hour; Voice ID remains independent
